subject: Laptop client won't finish syncing
body: My Tidewater client on my work laptop has been hanging at 99% since Monday. A few folders are stuck with the sync icon and never complete, even after I restarted the program.

subject: SSO login bounces back to login screen
body: Our team can't get in via single sign-on today. After authenticating we see Tidewater flash up and are then returned to the sign-in page again and again.

subject: No webhook events arriving
body: The webhook we use to push file events into our own system has gone quiet. The last event came in on Tuesday afternoon. Nothing is wrong with our server.

subject: iPhone stopped notifying me after app reinstall
body: Since I deleted and reinstalled Tidewater on my iPhone I no longer get push alerts for mentions. iOS notification permissions are on, and my tablet still gets them.

subject: 429 errors continue after moving to Business plan
body: We changed to the Business plan to get a higher API allowance. The nightly sync job still dies with too many requests errors at the same step as before.

subject: Shared calendar meetings displayed at the wrong hour
body: For part of our team the meetings in the shared calendar are shifted by an hour, and the rest see the correct time. Same meeting, different times on different screens.

subject: Recently uploaded files missing from search
body: Search gives no results for documents we added over the past few days, even with the exact title. Files from earlier weeks are found.

subject: Valid 2FA codes rejected at login
body: The six-digit codes from my authenticator app are rejected as invalid at login. I entered several new codes in a row, carefully.
